snippet.title: Depth of Mind - Official Indie Roguelike Game Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Depth of Mind is a roguelike game in which you have to immerse yourself in human consciousness to save his mind from diseases. Each run is unique with a set of operatives and reinforcements for them. The battles are a combination of JRPG and card games.

Play Depth of Mind on itch io!
https://funbanan.itch.io/ld57
